event_description: Fired when a user clicks on a news article card on the home page.
Fired when a signed-in user lands on an article details page and sees the full AI analysis — top of the authenticated content funnel.
Fired when a signed-out visitor clicks the Sign in button on the article analysis gate.
Fired when a signed-out visitor clicks the Create account button on the article analysis gate.
Fired when a user clicks the Subscribe button on the newsletter CTA section.
Fired when a signed-in user saves (bookmarks) an article on the details page. Not fired on unsave.
Fired when a user shares an article — via the native share sheet where available, else the clipboard-copy fallback.
Fired when a user clicks on a related story card on an article details page.
Server-side event fired when the manual scrape pipeline is invoked via POST /api/scrape.
Server-side event fired when the AI analysis pipeline is invoked via POST /api/analyze.
